description.tr: Mârifetnâme'si rasyonel bilimler ile tasavvufu sentezleyen benzersiz bir Osmanlı ansiklopedisidir || Osmanlı çevresinde yazarak hem Avrupa bilimsel gelişmelerine hem Doğu tasavvuf geleneğine erişti. || [Tarih notu] Mârifetnâme, Avrupa kaynaklarından alınmış anatomi çizimlerini içerir.
description.en: His Marifetname is a unique Ottoman synthesis of rational sciences and Sufi mysticism — an encyclopaedia attempting to unify empirical observation with spiritual cosmology || Writing in the Ottoman periphery, he accessed both European scientific developments and the Eastern Sufi tradition, producing a synthesis impossible in either centre alone. || [Historiographical note] Marifetname includes anatomical diagrams likely derived from European sources, showing the late Ottoman openness to Western science within a Sufi framework.
description.ar: معرفتنامته تركيب عثماني فريد بين العلوم العقلية والتصوف || كتب في الأطراف العثمانية فجمع بين التطورات العلمية الأوروبية والتقليد الصوفي الشرقي
